description: This code looks structurally simple — a single, unnested loop — so radon's cyclomatic complexity score will likely be very low. This is the SUBTLE case: it stress-tests whether the agent reasons about the ACTUAL runtime behavior rather than only trusting radon's structural score. Repeated string concatenation with += inside a loop is O(n^2) in CPython due to repeated copying; the fix is to collect pieces in a list and use ''.join() at the end.
performance_issues: String concatenation with += inside a loop causes O(n^2) behavior; use a list and ''.join() instead
